_about: Air-quality monitoring stations used by AeroMatrix. Continuous (CAAQMS) stations come with a published coordinate; manual (NAMP) stations and stations named only in the state report have no published coordinate in the supplied documents and are never placed on the map by guesswork.

_sources.CPCB list of CAAQM stations, All India: Central Pollution Control Board, list of Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations with agency and coordinates (358 stations).
_sources.NAMP manual network list (India, 19.11.2: Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Network (Manual) under NAMP as on 19.11.2024: Pune 3 stations, Pimpri-Chinchwad 1.
_sources.Air Quality Status Report of Maharashtra: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board, annual air quality status report 2022-23 (Pune Regional Office station list).
